## 1. Setup & Import

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

source(here('scripts', 'src', 'model_M2.R')) 
source(here('scripts', 'src', 'model_matrix_M2.R')) 

rds_path = here('data', 'processed')
rds_out_path = here('data', 'processed')

poly_data = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'poly_cleaned.rds'))
nodes = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'simulation_nodes.rds'))

static_data = get_static_data_m2_5(nodes)

file_name = 'm2b_mcmc'
m2b_mcmc = readRDS(here(rds_path, paste0(file_name, '.rds')))
```

## 2. Process MCMC Chain

```{r}
clean_chain = m2b_mcmc$mcmc_matrix

cat("Number of valid posterior samples across all chains:", nrow(clean_chain), "\n")
```

## 3. Sampling & Network Simulation

```{r}
set.seed(100)
n_sims = 700 # Depends on ESS

sample_indices = sample(1:nrow(clean_chain), n_sims, replace = FALSE)

edge_df_list = list()
sim_degree_list = list()
N = nrow(nodes)

# Network Generation Loop
for (i in 1:n_sims) {
  sampled_params = clean_chain[sample_indices[i], ]
  
  sim_network = generate_network_m2_3(sampled_params, static_data)
  
  if (sim_network$has_edge) {
    
    ego_ids = nodes$part_id[sim_network$rows]
    alter_ids = nodes$part_id[sim_network$cols]
    
    tmp_edges = data.frame(
      sim_id = i,
      part_id = c(ego_ids, alter_ids),
      cont_id = c(alter_ids, ego_ids)
    )
    edge_df_list[[i]] = tmp_edges
    
    node_degrees = tabulate(c(sim_network$rows, sim_network$cols), nbins = N)
  } else {
    node_degrees = rep(0, N)
  }
  
  sim_degree_list[[i]] = data.frame(
    sim_id = i,
    part_id = nodes$part_id,
    degree = node_degrees
  )
}

all_sim_edges_df = bind_rows(edge_df_list)
all_sim_degrees_df = bind_rows(sim_degree_list)
```

## 4. Calculate Indicators for Plots

### 4-1. Degree Distribution Data

```{r}
# Simulation
df_degree_sim = all_sim_degrees_df %>%
  count(sim_id, degree) %>%
  group_by(degree) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(n), 
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(source = "Simulation")

# POLYMOD
df_degree_poly = poly_data %>%
  count(part_id, name = "degree") %>%
  right_join(nodes %>% select(part_id), by = "part_id") %>%
  mutate(degree = replace_na(degree, 0)) %>%
  count(degree) %>%
  rename(mean_count = n) %>%
  mutate(source = "POLYMOD")

df_plot_degree = bind_rows(df_degree_sim, df_degree_poly)

saveRDS(df_plot_degree, here(rds_out_path, 'm2b_plot_data_degree.rds'))
```

### 4-2. Age Difference Data

```{r}
# Simulation
df_agediff_sim = all_sim_edges_df %>%
  left_join(nodes %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = "part_id") %>%
  rename(ego_age = part_age) %>%
  left_join(nodes %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = c("cont_id" = "part_id")) %>%
  rename(alter_age = part_age) %>%
  mutate(
    age_diff = alter_age - ego_age,
    abs_age_diff = abs(age_diff),
    source = "Simulation"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_diff)) %>%
  select(sim_id, age_diff, abs_age_diff, source)

# POLYMOD
df_agediff_poly = poly_data %>%
  mutate(
    age_diff = cnt_age - part_age,
    abs_age_diff = abs(age_diff),
    source = "POLYMOD"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_diff)) %>%
  select(age_diff, abs_age_diff, source)

saveRDS(df_agediff_sim, here(rds_out_path, 'm2b_plot_data_agediff_sim.rds'))
saveRDS(df_agediff_poly, here(rds_out_path, 'm2b_plot_data_agediff_poly.rds'))
```

### 4-3. 1-Year Resolution Diagonal Contacts

```{r}
nodes_clean = nodes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(part_id, part_age) %>%
  distinct(part_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Simulation
sim_diag_degrees = all_sim_edges_df %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean, by = "part_id") %>%
  rename(ego_age = part_age) %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean, by = c("cont_id" = "part_id")) %>%
  rename(alter_age = part_age) %>%
  filter(ego_age == alter_age) %>%
  count(sim_id, part_id, name = "diag_degree")
  
df_diag_sim = all_sim_degrees_df %>% 
  select(sim_id, part_id) %>% 
  left_join(sim_diag_degrees, by = c("sim_id", "part_id")) %>%
  mutate(diag_degree = replace_na(diag_degree, 0)) %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean, by = "part_id") %>%
  group_by(sim_id, part_age) %>%
  summarise(mean_contacts = mean(diag_degree), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(part_age) %>%
  summarise(mean_contacts = mean(mean_contacts), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  rename(age = part_age) %>%
  mutate(source = "Simulation")

# POLYMOD
df_diag_poly = poly_data %>%
  inner_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id), by = "part_id") %>% 
  filter(part_age == cnt_age) %>%
  count(part_id, name = "diag_degree") %>%
  right_join(nodes_clean, by = "part_id") %>% 
  mutate(diag_degree = replace_na(diag_degree, 0)) %>%
  group_by(part_age) %>%
  summarise(mean_contacts = mean(diag_degree), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  rename(age = part_age) %>%
  mutate(source = "POLYMOD")

df_plot_diag_1yr = bind_rows(df_diag_sim, df_diag_poly)

saveRDS(df_plot_diag_1yr, here(rds_out_path, 'm2b_plot_data_diag_1yr.rds'))
```

### 4-4. Mean Degree by Age Group Data

```{r}
breaks_5yr = seq(0, 80, by = 5)
labels_5yr = paste0(breaks_5yr[-length(breaks_5yr)], "-", breaks_5yr[-1] - 1)
labels_5yr[length(labels_5yr)] = "75-80" 

nodes_clean = nodes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(part_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Simulation
df_mean_deg_sim = all_sim_degrees_df %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = "part_id") %>%
  filter(part_age <= 80) %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(part_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(sim_id, age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_degree = mean(degree, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_degree = mean(mean_degree, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(source = "Simulation")

# POLYMOD
poly_degrees = poly_data %>%
  count(part_id, name = "degree") %>%
  right_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = "part_id") %>%
  mutate(degree = replace_na(degree, 0))

df_mean_deg_poly = poly_degrees %>%
  filter(part_age <= 80) %>% 
  mutate(age_group = cut(part_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_degree = mean(degree, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(source = "POLYMOD")

df_plot_mean_degree = bind_rows(df_mean_deg_sim, df_mean_deg_poly)

saveRDS(df_plot_mean_degree, here(rds_out_path, 'm2b_plot_data_mean_degree.rds'))
```

### 4-5. 5-Year Step Diagonal Contacts (binned)

```{r}
breaks_5yr = seq(0, 80, by = 5)
labels_5yr = paste0(breaks_5yr[-length(breaks_5yr)], "-", breaks_5yr[-1] - 1)
labels_5yr[length(labels_5yr)] = "75-80" 

nodes_clean = nodes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(part_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --- Simulation ---
sim_diag_step = all_sim_edges_df %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = "part_id") %>%
  rename(ego_age = part_age) %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = c("cont_id" = "part_id")) %>%
  rename(alter_age = part_age) %>%
  mutate(
    ego_group = cut(ego_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE),
    alter_group = cut(alter_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(ego_group == alter_group) %>%
  count(sim_id, part_id, name = "diag_count")

df_diag_step_sim = all_sim_degrees_df %>%
  select(sim_id, part_id) %>%
  left_join(sim_diag_step, by = c("sim_id", "part_id")) %>%
  mutate(diag_count = replace_na(diag_count, 0)) %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = "part_id") %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(part_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(sim_id, age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_contacts = mean(diag_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_contacts = mean(mean_contacts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(source = "Simulation")

# --- POLYMOD ---
df_diag_step_poly = poly_data %>%
  inner_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id), by = "part_id") %>%
  mutate(
    ego_group = cut(part_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE),
    alter_group = cut(cnt_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(ego_group == alter_group) %>%
  count(part_id, name = "diag_count") %>%
  right_join(nodes_clean, by = "part_id") %>%
  mutate(diag_count = replace_na(diag_count, 0)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(part_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_contacts = mean(diag_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(source = "POLYMOD")

df_plot_diag_step = bind_rows(df_diag_step_sim, df_diag_step_poly)

saveRDS(df_plot_diag_step, here(rds_out_path, 'm2b_plot_data_diag_step.rds'))
```

### 4-6. Contact Matrix Data (5-Year Binned)

```{r}
breaks_5yr = seq(0, 80, by = 5)
labels_5yr = paste0(breaks_5yr[-length(breaks_5yr)], "-", breaks_5yr[-1] - 1)
labels_5yr[length(labels_5yr)] = "75-80" 

# --- Simulation ---
df_matrix_sim = all_sim_edges_df %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = "part_id") %>%
  rename(ego_age = part_age) %>%
  left_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id, part_age), by = c("cont_id" = "part_id")) %>%
  rename(alter_age = part_age) %>%
  mutate(
    ego_group = cut(ego_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE),
    alter_group = cut(alter_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  count(sim_id, ego_group, alter_group, name = "count")

pop_by_group = nodes_clean %>%
  mutate(ego_group = cut(part_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  count(ego_group, name = "pop")

df_matrix_sim_final = expand.grid(
  sim_id = 1:n_sims,
  ego_group = labels_5yr,
  alter_group = labels_5yr
) %>%
  left_join(df_matrix_sim, by = c("sim_id", "ego_group", "alter_group")) %>%
  mutate(count = replace_na(count, 0)) %>%
  left_join(pop_by_group, by = "ego_group") %>%
  group_by(ego_group, alter_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_contacts = mean(count / pop), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(source = "Simulation")

# --- POLYMOD ---
df_matrix_poly_final = poly_data %>%
  inner_join(nodes_clean %>% select(part_id), by = "part_id") %>%
  mutate(
    ego_group = cut(part_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE),
    alter_group = cut(cnt_age, breaks = breaks_5yr, labels = labels_5yr, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  count(ego_group, alter_group, name = "count") %>%
  complete(ego_group = labels_5yr, alter_group = labels_5yr, fill = list(count = 0)) %>%
  left_join(pop_by_group, by = "ego_group") %>%
  mutate(mean_contacts = count / pop, source = "POLYMOD")

df_plot_heatmap = bind_rows(df_matrix_sim_final, df_matrix_poly_final)
saveRDS(df_plot_heatmap, here(rds_out_path, 'm2b_plot_data_heatmap.rds'))
```
